ideas.pitch: A multi-agent network simulation tool modeling Doctor Doom's infrastructure to help resistance fighters practice automated penetration testing.
ideas.problem_statement: Doctor Doom has taken over global systems and set a Doomsday countdown. You play the resistance, breaking into his networks.
ideas.title: DoomNet Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the multi-agent simulation pattern from successful security hackathon entries, offering a practical tool for training against complex cyber threats.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent cryptographic hint decoder and phased challenge tracker built for rapid CTF flag acquisition.
ideas.problem_statement: The challenges are released in phases and get harder as the event goes on. Beginners will find plenty to solve, and experienced players will find a serious final challenge.
ideas.title: ChronoDecoder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact fatigue and time-management bottlenecks of a 24-hour solo CTF by automating pattern recognition across challenge phases.

ideas.pitch: A secure zero-knowledge credential verification system for the resistance to verify team intelligence without revealing source nodes.
ideas.problem_statement: You play the resistance, breaking into his networks, decoding his secrets and shutting down his plan before time runs out.
ideas.title: ResistLedger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements advanced cryptographic patterns suited for secure communication simulation in a sci-fi CTF narrative.

ideas.pitch: A browser companion that filters distraction vectors and provides instant reference lookup for common CTF vulnerability classes during competition hours.
ideas.problem_statement: Doctor Doom has taken over global systems and set a Doomsday countdown. You play the resistance, breaking into his networks, decoding his secrets and shutting down his plan before time runs out.
ideas.title: DoomGuard Extension
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets solo competitor productivity and focus based on proven extension-based productivity wins.

ideas.pitch: An interactive educational dashboard designed to teach beginner CTF players basic web exploitation and cryptography fundamentals.
ideas.problem_statement: Beginners will find plenty to solve, and experienced players will find a serious final challenge.
ideas.title: CyberSentinel Academy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies proven cybersecurity education frameworks that resonate strongly with judges looking for community value and beginner accessibility.
